kjv: ye (Israel) have borne the tabernacle of your Moloch and Chiun your images
mine: You (Israel) shall take up Sikkuth your king, and Kiyyun your star-god
note: Sikkut and Kiyyun are the Mesopotamian astral deities Sakkut and Kaiwan (Saturn), vocalised in MT like shiqquts "abomination"; KJV's "tabernacle of your Moloch" blends the LXX (quoted in Acts 7:43) with the Hebrew malkekhem "your king".

kjv: That strengtheneth the spoiled against the strong
mine: who makes destruction flash forth against the strong
note: hammavlig shod is "who makes destruction flash/smile" (balag "brighten"), part of a doxology of God's power, not the empowerment of the plundered.
